visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with an Asian male presenter centered in a medium close-up shot. He is wearing a dark black collared shirt and modern glasses. His hands are visible at the bottom of the frame, holding a blue pen and occasionally gesturing for emphasis. The background is a vibrant digital overlay of orange-red salmon roe filling the entire frame. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a studio setting. A banner at the top invites viewers to join the PanSci membership. (2) The scene shifts to a scientific animation illustrating RNA molecules. Red and blue double-helix structures are shown floating and rotating against a dark, slightly textured blue background with smaller biological particles. The animation uses a smooth, digital style with subtle light reflections on the strands. There are no people visible in this phase. The text overlay introduces the concept of RNA as a fundamental molecule for life. (3) The camera cuts back to the male presenter in the same studio setup. He continues his narration with animated facial expressions, emphasizing certain words with movements of his head and eyes. He gestures with his right hand holding the blue pen. The salmon roe background remains consistent, providing a high-contrast backdrop to his black attire. Bright studio lighting ensures his features are clearly visible. (4) A graphic illustration appears on a white background with a vertical layout. It features icons: an orange padlock labeled 'TLR7', a grey key labeled 'acp3U', and a grey oval icon representing sugar molecules. The presenter's voice explains the function of these biological components. No real people are seen, but the icons represent complex immune system sensors. The lighting in this segment is flat and clean, typical of informational graphics. (5) The visual transitions back to the RNA animation, but this time a subtitle explicitly mentions the 'no acp3U version of RNA.' The same red and blue helixes are shown moving through the dark blue space. The animation maintains its dynamic and clear visual style to help the audience visualize the microscopic process being discussed. (6) The final phase returns to the presenter for the concluding remarks. He looks directly at the camera, maintaining engagement with the audience. His hands continue to hold the pen, gesturing towards the camera as he discusses the potential medical implications of the research. The salmon roe background and the top banner remain in place, with standard studio lighting concluding the segment.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 加入泛科學會員 一起撐開腦洞. [Slogan]: 新! 抗自體免疫攻擊方. [Subtitle]: 不是你欠揍. (2) [Subtitle]: 但你的免疫系統天生就想揍你. (3) [Subtitle]: 那大多數人到底是如何跟自己相安無事的? (4) [Subtitle]: 現在科學家終於發現了那個秘密設計. (5) [Subtitle]: RNA也就是核糖核酸大家都聽過. (6) [Subtitle]: 是地球上所有生命的基礎分子之一. (7) [Subtitle]: 是傳遞遺傳訊息的「信差」. (8) [Subtitle]: 但對流感、新冠病毒等病毒來說. (9) [Subtitle]: RNA就是全部的遺傳密碼. (10) [Subtitle]: 所以訓練有素的免疫系統. (11) [Subtitle]: 一看到裸露的RNA. (12) [Subtitle]: 二話不說就開幹. (13) [Subtitle]: 但但但但. (14) [Subtitle]: 那免疫系統為何不攻擊. (15) [Subtitle]: 自己細胞表面的RNA呢? (16) [Subtitle]: 由康乃狄克大學醫學院. (17) [Subtitle]: 和波士頓兒童醫院等團隊. (18) [Subtitle]: 發表在《自然》上的研究指出. (19) [Subtitle]: 我們身體會幫自己的RNA. (20) [Subtitle]: 接上各種醣分子. (21) [Subtitle]: 讓免疫系統沒有反應. (22) [Subtitle]: 簡單來說. (23) [Subtitle]: 免疫系統的感測器. (24) [Subtitle]: 例如TLR7. (25) [Subtitle]: 像一個只認特定鑰匙的鎖. (26) [Subtitle]: 而我們RNA上有一種叫. (27) [Subtitle]: acp^3U的特殊化學記號. (28) [Subtitle]: 就是那把鑰匙. (29) [Subtitle]: 一旦鑰匙插進鎖裡. (30) [Subtitle]: 就會觸發警報. (31) [Subtitle]: 引發第一型干擾素的發炎反應. (32) [Subtitle]: 但但但但. (33) [Subtitle]: 我們自己的RNA上. (34) [Subtitle]: 這把acp^3U鑰匙. (35) [Subtitle]: 都被「醣」分子做成的貞操套. (36) [Subtitle]: 啊不是 是鑰匙套蓋住了. (37) [Subtitle]: 鑰匙插不進鎖裡. (38) [Subtitle]: 免疫系統自然就安靜無聲. (39) [Subtitle]: 重點來了. (40) [Subtitle]: 為了證明這把鑰匙是關鍵. (41) [Subtitle]: 科學家使了釜底抽薪之計. (42) [Subtitle]: 他們想 如果acp^3U真的是那把鑰匙. (43) [Subtitle]: 我乾脆讓你連這把鑰匙都「生」不出來. (44) [Subtitle]: 看你怎麼開鎖. (45) [Subtitle]: 在我們細胞裡 製造acp^3U. (46) [Subtitle]: 需要一個特定的酵素DTWD2. (47) [Subtitle]: 於是呢 科學家周基因編輯. (48) [Subtitle]: 把製造DTWD2的「基因說明書」刪掉. (49) [Subtitle]: 這麼一來 細胞生產不出DTWD2. (50) [Subtitle]: 也就沒辦法在RNA上. (51) [Subtitle]: 做出acp^3U這把鑰匙了. (52) [Subtitle]: 夠複雜. (53) [Subtitle]: 還沒完 他們最後把這種天生沒有鑰匙的RNA. (54) [Subtitle]: 光溜溜地丟給免疫系統. (55) [Subtitle]: 免疫系統完全沒反應. (56) [Subtitle]: 證明了acp^3U就是那個會觸發警報的鑰匙. (57) [Subtitle]: 而「醣鑰匙套」的唯一工作. (58) [Subtitle]: 就是把這鑰匙收好 案子就這麼破了. (59) [Subtitle]: 這發現可重要了. (60) [Subtitle]: 你看 我們每天都有細胞死掉. (61) [Subtitle]: 如果這些屍體裡的RNA都沒戴好鑰匙套. (62) [Subtitle]: 那免疫系統不就天天對我們自己施暴. (63) [Subtitle]: 或許紅斑性狼瘡這種自體免疫疾病的病因之一. (64) [Subtitle]: 搞不好就是病人的RNA醣基化出了問題. (65) [Subtitle]: 這下免疫學的一大謎團解開. (66) [Subtitle]: 未來或許可以幫RNA藥物或疫苗. (67) [Subtitle]: 戴上「醣」做的套套. (68) [Subtitle]: 讓它們得以躲過免疫系統的追殺 精準達成任務. (69) [Subtitle]: 不過小羅伯特甘迺迪的追殺 大概是躲不過.
